I need to calculate 50! and then sum its decimal digits. Let me do this step-by-step using Python.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Calculate 50!
factorial_50 = math.factorial(50)
print(f"50! = {factorial_50}")

# Convert to string to access individual digits
digits_str = str(factorial_50)
print(f"\nNumber of digits: {len(digits_str)}")

# Sum all the digits
digit_sum = sum(int(d) for d in digits_str)
print(f"\nSum of all digits: {digit_sum}")

# Show the calculation
print(f"\nDigits: {' + '.join(digits_str)}")
print(f"= {digit_sum}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
